scenes.title:
Clearer views.
A refined flight.
lines: Refined image quality during camera movement
Your saved flight profile stays with you
scenes.narration: Discover the latest F S R update for X Plane. This release refines image reconstruction during camera movement, with Native A A and upscaling options for F S R three and four.

scenes.title: Compare the same scene.
scenes.narration: Compare the same ten eighty p scene with processing off, then F S R three Native A A active. Look at the wing and runway edges in these sequential captures.

scenes.title: Start with a preset.
scenes.narration: Choose a preset for your display. Native A A keeps full internal resolution. Quality reconstructs a larger output from fewer pixels. F S R four is an experimental option for compatible hardware.

scenes.title:
1440p in.
4K out.
lines: FXAA Off  /  start with MSAA Off
scenes.narration: For four K Quality, choose four K output with fourteen forty p input. The output setting determines your final resolution. Leave F X A A off, and start with M S A A off.

scenes.title:
Saved choices.
Visible confirmation.
lines: Help explains settings and their intended use
Live status confirms active FSR processing
scenes.narration: Your selections return when you reopen the app. Help explains each setting and its intended use. The live status confirms when F S R processing is active.

scenes.title: Ready for changing views.
lines: Automatic native rendering near ground contact
Raise the external camera above 2.5 m to resume FSR
Built-in frame generation is unavailable in this preview
scenes.narration: Rendering adapts as you change views. Near ground contact, the app can select native rendering automatically. Raise the external camera above two point five metres to resume F S R. Built in frame generation is unavailable in this preview.

scenes.title:
A short guide
with each update.
lines: Plays once for each installed version
Skip immediately  /  replay from What's new
Turn future update videos off at any time
scenes.narration: Each update includes a short feature guide. Skip whenever you like, replay from Whats New, or switch future videos off. Choose your profile, and enjoy your flight.
